passage.label: indeed mankind created anxious evil touches impatient good touches withholding; except observers prayer constant prayer; within wealth known right petitioner deprived; believe Day Recompense; fearful punishment Lord indeed punishment Lord not safe; guard private parts except wives right hands possess not blamed whoever seeks beyond transgressors; trusts promises attentive; testimonies upright; carefully maintain prayer; gardens honored

arabicExcerpts.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ

mainSubject.label: Mankind declared created anxious — impatient when evil touches and withholding when good touches — with the exception of the prayer-observers who are constant in prayer; those whose wealth carries a known right for the petitioner and the deprived; believers in the Day of Recompense who fear their Lord's punishment since it offers no security; those guarding their private parts except with wives or rightful possessions without blame, while whoever seeks beyond is a transgressor; those attentive to trusts and promises, upright in testimony and careful in maintaining prayer — these will be honoured in gardens

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the hoarding-and-turning-away indictment (18) before the human-nature diagnosis opens (19); P2 ends with the honoured-in-gardens verdict (35) before the disbeliever-hastening question begins (36); P3 runs through the garden-aspiration refusal and the replacement oath (36-41); P4 covers the leave-them instruction, the grave-emergence scene and the closing humiliation statement (42-44).
